verification_vocabulary: Same as GRAPH-FORMAT.md: bibliographic_metadata_checked = identity/edition checked; supporting_page_checked = an abstract, contents page or opening text was read for the specific point in the note; unverified = do not cite yet. No book was read in full.

sections.origins_precursors: Earlier settler-society and settler-capitalism scholarship, and the first uses of the name in the 1990s and 2000s.
sections.theory: Works that name settler colonialism and theorise it as a distinct formation, or programme it as a field.
sections.indigenous_critique_resurgence: Indigenous political theory and critique read alongside the paradigm. Several also critique it.
sections.canadian_historiography: Canadian historical writing on dispossession, reserves, gender, health, labour and settler identity. Some of it predates the paradigm or does not adopt it.
sections.comparative_adjacent: Comparative and adjacent works the PhD data place nearby.
sections.critiques: Published critiques and reassessments of the paradigm.
